    .first-run-activity { margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #395459; border-radius: 12px; }

    body[data-first-activity="rune"] .profile-control:not(.rune), body[data-first-activity="rune"] .result-card:not(.rune),

    body[data-first-activity="potion"] .profile-control:not(.potion), body[data-first-activity="potion"] .result-card:not(.potion) { display: none; }
    body[data-first-activity]:not([data-first-activity="all"]) .profile-controls,
    body[data-first-activity]:not([data-first-activity="all"]) .result-cards { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); }
    #planner, #results-panel { scroll-margin-top: 16px; }

<script>
    // View-only activity selection. Never writes planner settings, URL, or storage.
    document.body.dataset.firstActivity = 'rune';
    document.getElementById('activity-start').addEventListener('change', event => {
      if (event.target.name === 'first-activity') document.body.dataset.firstActivity = event.target.value;
    });
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      if (document.getElementById('custom-budget-enabled').checked) document.querySelector('.first-run-budget').open = true;
    });
  </script>
